steps.text: The Character Select editor: how a playable character shows up on Character Select, in Freeplay (its DJ) and on the results screen.
Player: its id, its name, its place on the grid, the characters it owns and where the file is saved. Save and Reload are here.
Player Sheet: a spritesheet (.png and .xml) for the character instead of a texture atlas. Only Vortex shows it: V-Slice needs the atlas.
Girlfriend: the one next to the character on the screen, and her speakers.
Freeplay DJ: who is on the turntable in Freeplay, with its offsets and texts.
Results: the animations and the music of each rank on the results screen.
Animation preview: play any animation to check it.
What you save here works in the official V-Slice too (except the spritesheet). Have fun!
